odoo.task: design-checklist (the piece's own comparison: contacts list of 100,000 with a contact open, contact form, settings screens; EN/AR; light/dark/hc)
odoo.notes: Same screens in both products at 1440x900, judged against the spec's checklist. Ours better on: locale formats (dd/mm/yyyy, AED beside amounts), themes (light, dark and high contrast; Odoo Community has only light), contrast (my scan found 0 text elements under WCAG AA in all three themes), Arabic right to left with Readex Pro, density, and a clear single primary action (violet New contact / Save). Odoo better on 'no clipped text'. Ours: 28 of the visible contacts-list cells are cut with an ellipsis and have no title or tooltip on hover. The search placeholder is cut ('...reference or TRI', also in Arabic). The record pane's section tabs are cut ('Cc'). The licensing-authority value on the company form is cut. There is no column resizing (0 resize handles). Odoo, same list: 0 cells cut, 5 column resize handles. Odoo is also better on 'icons': our navigation and record command bar have no icons. Loading states: ours has no skeletons. Ours must be at least as good on every item, so this task is lost. The builder's record does not name it as a known loss. Screenshots 02, 03, 10, 11.
Pointer path; keystrokes left out (0 in both). Same as the earlier judged ours numbers (1/0/2.65); not worse after p18.
Path 'national'. Same as the p01 r14 baseline 2/9/5.57.
Path goTo. Same as the baseline.
Path palette-shortest, with ERP_SEED_CONTACTS_CSV. Same as the p16 r2 baseline 3/14/5.67.
Path initials. Same as the p05 r15 baseline 3/3/8.29.
Keystrokes left out (0 in both). Same as the baseline.

The harness's ours driver reports not_built ('waits for p04 with p16'). Odoo measured 9 steps, 10 keys, 7.25 s.

biggest_gap.title: Text is still cut off with no way to read it, and the side-by-side checklist is lost to Odoo
biggest_gap.detail: The spec asks for 'column resizing and no text cut off without a tooltip' and names the reviewers' fix 'names cut in lists with no way to read them'. In the contacts list (100,000 rows, 1440 px wide), names, organisations, e-mails and emirates end in an ellipsis. The cell has no title, and hovering shows no tooltip. No column can be resized, and the Status column is pushed off screen. Other text is cut too: the search placeholder ('...reference or TRI' in English, the Arabic one as well), the record pane's section tabs ('Cc'), and long input values on the company form. Odoo's list of the same 100,000 contacts cuts no cell and offers 5 column resize handles. design.spec.ts checks only buttons, inputs, tabs and badges whose own box overflows, so it misses list cells, placeholders and tabs cut off by their container.
biggest_gap.evidence: Sign in as admin@alnoor.example, press G then O, and hover over 'Al Noor Electromechanical LLC 15'. No tooltip appears. In the browser: [...document.querySelectorAll('td')].filter(c=>c.scrollWidth>c.clientWidth+1 && !c.title).length gives 28, and document.querySelectorAll('[role=separator]').length gives 0. Press ArrowDown, then Enter: the section tabs show 'Contact, How to reach, Address, Registration, Cc'. Same list in Odoo (localhost:8069/odoo/contacts?view_type=list): 0 cut cells, 5 .o_resize handles. Screenshots 02, 03, 10. Scripts: scripts/c.mjs, scripts/final.mjs.

other_findings: Scope missing from direction G and the p18 spec (checked in the browser and the source). The Ctrl K palette has no '>' commands, no '#' documents and no Tab for a record's actions: '>' and '#' both answer 'Nothing matches' (screenshot 04). The sidebar has no pinned or recent items, no icons and no collapsible groups. The record command bar has no icons and no overflow menu (Print, History, Archive, Save and Close are text buttons). There are no toasts, no loading skeletons and no tooltip component (grep finds none in web/src). Drop-down and look-up fields with search are missing: Type, Emirate, Country (about 250 entries) and Fiscal month are still native selects, and Base currency is a plain text box. The date picker is the browser's native one, pointer-only (tabIndex -1), with no date-range picker and no tag field. There are no sparklines, trend column, 12-month trend or recent activity on the dashboard.

Theme and density are kept per device, not per user as the spec says ('chosen per user and remembered', 'kept per user'). After admin chose Dark and Comfortable and signed out, erp.theme stayed 'dark' for the next person on the browser. A user on another device starts again from the system setting.

Keyboard access: the record pane's section tabs and the date calendar button have tabIndex -1, so the spec's 'every control reachable and operable by keyboard' is not met for them (their function can partly be reached by tabbing through fields and typing dates).

The home dashboard summary is not useful at real volume. 'Users who never signed in' is marked attention, so admin sees '103,668 things need you today'. The read-only viewer@alnoor.example sees '103,666 things need you today' for failed jobs and invitations it cannot act on. The first card labels the active count (97,836) 'Contacts', while the Contacts list says '100,006 contacts'.

Layout. On the exchange-rates list in high contrast, the toolbar wraps onto a second line and the list's key hint ('↑↓ move · Enter open...') sits under the status bar. On the company form, the space under the Code field is uneven.

Load-sensitive test (not a p18 regression, already known from serial-19 and serial-22): web/src/modules/shell/clientIsolation.test.tsx's first test takes about 20 s of its 30 s limit on a quiet machine, the same before p18 (dbc81aac: 20.2 s) and after (20.3 s). At load 72-79 it timed out and 9 more cascaded in my run 1. Not loosened or retried; run 2 passed.
[route: p01-odoo-rig] The harness's keyboard-navigation task still reports ours not_built ('waits for p04 with p16'), although both pieces are integrated, so the task is never compared.
